messages.content: Who are in the cricket matches scheduled for today?

function.name: sports_analyzer_get_schedule
function.description: Retrieve the schedule of cricket matches for a specific date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date for which to get the schedule of matches.

sport.description: The type of sport. Default is cricket.

country.description: The country for which to get the schedule. If not provided, all countries will be included. Default: 'USA'
